protocol.selection: Maximize the worse of two development-fold net P&Ls; tie-break by name. No validation input.
protocol.pass_rule: Both development folds: net>0, trades>=20, PF>=1.15. Validation: net>0, trades>=30, PF>=1.15, day-block bootstrap 95% lower>0. Doubled-cost validation net>0.
notes: Earlier, newly downloaded market history; independent of the first seven-day sample
This is retrospective validation, not prospective forward evidence
No access to trades.db, .env, or the previous testnet trade records
Fees 5 bps/side, slip 2 bps/side, spread 4 bps; stress doubles fees/slip
Historical funding uses actual event mark/rate, settled at minute-open before entries
No historical book depth, partial fills or historical exchange lot limits
No automatic activation or default strategy change

uncertainty.method: IID resampling of whole UTC days, preserving within-day trade correlation; few days limits confidence

fixed_trade_cost_stress.method: Same positions, size and exit timestamps; double fees/adverse slippage. Not a replay of changed stops or liquidity.
